Tabata Timer

A real Tabata / HIIT interval timer: configurable prep, work and rest seconds, round counter and chime on every interval change.

Ready
0:10

A chime sounds on every interval change. Timing uses wall-clock timestamps.

📖 How to use

  1. Set rounds, work seconds, rest seconds and prep countdown.
  2. Press Start — the timer runs Prep → Work/Rest → … → Complete automatically.
  3. Watch the round counter and the current phase label.
  4. Pause any time, or Reset to start over.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is Tabata?

A high-intensity interval protocol: 20 seconds of all-out work followed by 10 seconds of rest, repeated for 8 rounds (4 minutes). Every interval here is configurable.

Does it keep time in a background tab?

Yes — it uses wall-clock timestamps, so intervals stay accurate even when the tab is not in focus.

What happens after the last round?

The timer chimes and shows “Complete!” — there is no rest interval after the final work round.
